blurb.en: Listen for times, dates and prices, and find the right picture when plans change.
blurb.vi: Nghe giờ, ngày tháng và giá tiền, và tìm đúng bức tranh khi kế hoạch thay đổi.

half past.def: Thirty minutes after the hour. We write 6:30 for six thirty.
half past.ex: The film starts at *half past* six, so write 6:30.

quarter past.def: Fifteen minutes after the hour, for example 9:15 or 2:15.
quarter past.ex: The coach leaves at *quarter past* eight, so write 8:15.

quarter to.def: Fifteen minutes before the next hour, for example 4:45 or 9:45.
quarter to.ex: Please come at *quarter to* ten. That's 9:45.

date.def: The day and the month, for example the ninth of May.
date.ex: The *date* of our trip is the third of November.

timetable.def: A list that shows the times of lessons, buses or trains.
timetable.ex: Look at the *timetable*. We have art on Thursday.

ticket.def: A small card or paper that you buy to go into a show or onto a train.
ticket.ex: My *ticket* for the school play cost five pounds.

price.def: How much money you pay for something.
price.ex: The *price* of the trip is nine pounds.

register.def: A list of names. The teacher reads it to check who is at school.
register.ex: Our teacher takes the *register* at eight o'clock every morning.

costume.def: Special clothes that you wear to look like someone else, for a show or a festival.
costume.ex: In the old classroom, we all wore a *costume* from the past.

packed lunch.def: Food that you bring from home in a box or bag to eat at lunchtime.
packed lunch.ex: We don't need a *packed lunch*, because the café gives us soup.

instead.def: In the place of something else.
instead.ex: The museum was closed, so we went to the zoo *instead*.

actually.def: A word people say before the true information, often to correct someone.

sold out.def: There are none left in the shop, so you cannot buy one.
sold out.ex: The strawberry cakes were *sold out*, so Raj bought cupcakes.

changed his mind.def: Made a new choice that is different from his first choice.
changed his mind.ex: Nam wanted pizza, but he *changed his mind* and chose soup.

scenes.head: Listen to Nam and his dad. What will Nam take to the school fair?
scenes.html:
Nam: Dad, I want to make a chocolate cake for the school fair on Friday.
Dad: Our oven is broken, Nam. We can't bake a cake this week.
Nam: Oh no. What about a pizza from the shop?
Dad: Pizza gets cold. Let's make a big bowl of *fruit salad instead*.
Nam: OK. Everyone likes fruit salad.

audio.head: Listen to Nam and his dad.
lines: Dad, I want to make a chocolate cake for the school fair on Friday.
Our oven is broken, Nam. We can't bake a cake this week.
Oh no. What about a pizza from the shop?
Pizza gets cold. Let's make a big bowl of fruit salad instead.

steps.en: Nam and Dad talk about three foods: a *cake*, a *pizza* and *fruit salad*. In Part 1 all three pictures are said.
steps.vi: Nam và bố nói về ba món: bánh ngọt, pizza và salad hoa quả. Ở Phần 1, cả ba bức tranh đều được nhắc đến.

steps.en: The oven is *broken*, so the cake is not possible. Pizza *gets cold*, so that is not the choice.
steps.vi: Lò nướng bị hỏng nên không làm bánh được. Pizza bị nguội nên cũng không được chọn.

steps.en: Listen for *instead*. The new plan is the answer: *fruit salad*.
steps.vi: Hãy nghe từ *instead*. Kế hoạch mới là đáp án: salad hoa quả.

title.vi: Khi ai đó sửa lại thông tin

scenes.head: Listen to Clara and her mum. What time do the fireworks start?
scenes.html:
Clara: Mum, the fireworks start at eight o'clock, don't they?
Mum: *No, that was last year*. This year they start at *half past eight*. They finish at nine.
Clara: So can we leave home at eight?
Mum: Yes. It's only a short walk to the river.

audio.head: Listen to Clara and her mum.
lines: Mum, the fireworks start at eight o'clock, don't they?
No, that was last year. This year they start at half past eight. They finish at nine.
So can we leave home at eight?
Yes. It's only a short walk to the river.

steps.en: Clara says a time, but Mum *corrects* her. Listen for *No* and *that was last year*.
steps.vi: Clara nói một giờ, nhưng mẹ sửa lại. Hãy nghe *No* và *that was last year*.

steps.en: Three times are said: *eight*, *half past eight* and *nine*. Only one answers the question.
steps.vi: Có ba giờ được nói: tám giờ, tám rưỡi và chín giờ. Chỉ một giờ trả lời đúng câu hỏi.

steps.en: The question says *start*. This year the fireworks start at *half past eight*: 8:30.
steps.vi: Câu hỏi hỏi giờ *bắt đầu*. Năm nay pháo hoa bắt đầu lúc tám rưỡi: 8:30.

title.vi: Ghi chú từ lời cô giáo

scenes.head: Listen to the teacher. SPORTS DAY notes: Date: ____ May / Arrive at: ____ / New race: a ____ race
scenes.html: Teacher: Good morning, everyone. Our Sports Day is on the *ninth* of May. Please come to school at *quarter past eight*, not at the usual time. Every child will run in two races. Last year we had a long jump, but this year we're having a *sack* race instead. Please wear your sports clothes and bring a hat and a water bottle.

audio.head: Listen to the teacher talking about Sports Day.
lines: Good morning, everyone. Our Sports Day is on the ninth of May. Please come to school at quarter past eight, not at the usual time. Every child will run in two races. Last year we had a long jump, but this year we're having a sack race instead. Please wear your sports clothes and bring a hat and a water bottle.

steps.en: In Part 2 you complete notes with *one word* or *a number*. Read the notes first.
steps.vi: Ở Phần 2, em hoàn thành ghi chú bằng một từ hoặc một con số. Hãy đọc ghi chú trước.

steps.en: *The ninth of May*: May is printed, so you only write *9*.
steps.vi: *The ninth of May*: chữ May đã in sẵn, nên em chỉ viết số 9.

steps.en: *Quarter past eight* means 8:15. You can write it as a number.
steps.vi: *Quarter past eight* nghĩa là 8 giờ 15. Em có thể viết bằng số.

steps.en: A long jump was *last year*. This year it is a *sack* race.
steps.vi: Nhảy xa là của năm ngoái. Năm nay là chạy nhảy bao bố (sack race).

end.en: Great listening! You caught the changed plans, the corrections and the numbers.
end.vi: Nghe giỏi lắm! Em đã bắt được những kế hoạch thay đổi, những lần sửa lại và các con số.

v.q: What did Elliot buy for his sister?
whys: Grace guessed a book, but Elliot says his sister has lots of books.
Elliot wanted the necklace, but it was too expensive.
v.hint: Grace makes a guess. Does Elliot agree with it?
v.worked: Elliot says "So I got her a *puzzle* with a picture of a horse."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and Grace.
lines: Grace, I bought a present for my sister's birthday today.
Was it a book? She loves reading.
She's got lots of books. I wanted to get her a necklace, but it was too expensive. So I got her a puzzle with a picture of a horse.

v.q: What does Tuan's grandpa do every morning now?
whys: Grandpa used to go fishing, but his back hurts now.
Cycling is what Ngoc's grandma does. Grandpa says it is too fast.
v.hint: The question says now. Listen for what Grandpa stopped and what he does now.
v.worked: Tuan says "*Now* he does *yoga* in the park with his friends."

stim.head: Listen to Ngoc and Tuan.
lines: Tuan, does your grandpa still go fishing every morning?
Not now. His back hurts when he sits by the lake. Now he does yoga in the park with his friends.
My grandma rides her bike every morning.
Grandpa says cycling is too fast for him!

v.q: Which day is Aisha's dance show?
whys: Friday is the last practice, not the show.
On Sunday Aisha is going to her aunt's house.
v.hint: Raj guesses two days. Listen to what Aisha says about each day.
v.worked: Aisha says "The show is on *Saturday* afternoon."

stim.head: Listen to Aisha and Raj.
lines: Raj, my dance show is next week. Can you come?
I'd love to! Is it on Friday or Sunday?
Neither! Friday is the last practice, and on Sunday we're going to my aunt's. The show is on Saturday afternoon.
Great. I play football on Saturday morning, but I'm free after lunch.

v.q: How much was Lucy's ticket for the aquarium?
whys: Ten pounds is the price for adults.
It was free for Lucy's baby brother, not for Lucy.
v.hint: Who pays which price? Lucy is a child.
v.worked: Lucy says "*Children pay six pounds*."

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and Jack.
lines: Jack, I went to the aquarium yesterday. It was amazing!
How much was the ticket? Was it ten pounds?
Ten pounds is the price for adults. Children pay six pounds. And my baby brother was free!
That's not bad. I want to go too.

v.q: What has Jack's family run out of?
whys: There are lots of eggs, but Jack doesn't like them.
There is a whole loaf of bread, so Jack can have toast.
v.hint: Run out of means there is none left. Listen for the word sorry.
v.worked: Mum says "Sorry, we've *run out of milk*."

stim.head: Listen to Jack and his mum.
lines: Mum, can I have cereal? Is there any milk?
Sorry, we've run out of milk. But there are lots of eggs.
I don't like eggs. Can I have toast?
Yes, there's a whole loaf of bread.

v.q: Where did Ngoc sleep on holiday?
whys: Raj asks about a hotel, but Ngoc says no.
The flat in the city is where Raj stays, at his grandma's.
v.hint: Raj asks a question. Is Ngoc's answer yes or no?
v.worked: Ngoc says "*No*, we stayed in a *tent* by a lake."

stim.head: Listen to Ngoc and Raj.
lines: Raj, we went to the mountains for our holiday.
Lucky you! Did you stay in a hotel?
No, we stayed in a tent by a lake. It was cold at night!
We always stay in my grandma's flat in the city.

v.q: What is Grace afraid of?
whys: Grace thinks spiders are interesting. She isn't afraid of them.
Elliot is the one who is afraid of the dark.
v.hint: Listen for afraid of. Who says it?
v.worked: Grace says "But *I'm afraid of dogs*."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and Grace.
lines: Grace, are you afraid of spiders?
No, I think they're interesting. But I'm afraid of dogs. A big dog chased me once.
Really? I'm afraid of the dark!
I'm not. I like looking at the stars at night.

v.q: What time will Raj's family eat dinner tonight?
whys: Seven is the time Grandpa's train arrives.
Five is the time for Raj's snack.
v.hint: Three times are said. Which one goes with dinner?
v.worked: Mum says "*We'll eat at eight*."

stim.head: Listen to Raj and his mum.
lines: Mum, are we eating dinner at seven tonight?
No. Grandpa's coming, and his train arrives at seven. We'll eat at eight.
That's late! Can I have a snack at five?
Yes, but only a small one.

blurb.en: Practise times, prices and dates, then the traps, then short notes.
blurb.vi: Luyện nghe giờ, giá tiền và ngày tháng, rồi các bẫy, rồi ghi chú ngắn.

title.vi: Giờ, giá tiền, thứ và ngày tháng

v.q: What time does Lucy's piano lesson start today?
whys: Four o'clock is the usual time, but not today.
Half past five is when the lesson finishes.
v.hint: The question says today. Is today a usual day?
v.worked: Dad says "*Today it starts at half past four*." That is 4:30.

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her dad.
lines: Dad, my piano lesson is at four o'clock today, isn't it?
Usually it's at four, but your teacher phoned. Today it starts at half past four.
OK. And it finishes at half past five?
That's right. I'll pick you up then.

v.q: What time does the singing start at the school concert?
whys: Six o'clock is when the doors open.
Half past seven is when the concert ends.
v.hint: Listen for the word singing. Which time goes with it?
v.worked: Clara says "The *singing starts at quarter past six*." That is 6:15.

stim.head: Listen to Tuan and Clara.
lines: Clara, the school concert starts at six, right?
The doors open at six. The singing starts at quarter past six.
At about half past seven. Then there are drinks and snacks.

v.q: How much does Aisha pay?
whys: Three pounds is the price of the big bunch. Aisha takes the small one.
The pineapples cost one pound fifty, but Aisha says no, thank you.
v.hint: Two bunches have two prices. Which bunch does Aisha take?
v.worked: The small bunch is "*two pounds*" and Aisha says "I'll take the *small one*".

stim.head: Listen to Aisha at the market.
lines: Excuse me, how much is a bunch of bananas?
The small bunch is two pounds, and the big bunch is three pounds.
I'll take the small one, please. And how much are the pineapples?
No, thank you. Just the bananas.

v.q: How much is Mum's ticket for the school play?
whys: Four pounds was the price last year.
Two pounds is the price for children under six.
v.hint: Nam says one price, then he corrects it. Listen for sorry.
v.worked: Nam says "*This year it's five pounds*."

stim.head: Listen to Nam and his mum.
lines: Mum, can you come to our school play? Tickets are four pounds.
Four pounds? That's the same as last year.
Oh, sorry. Last year it was four. This year it's five pounds.
That's fine. And your little sister?
Children under six pay two pounds.

v.q: Which day is Tuan's visit to the dentist?
whys: Monday was the old day, but the dentist is busy then.
Tuesday is Tuan's football day.
v.hint: Mum has moved the visit. Listen for the new day.
v.worked: Mum says "*It's on Wednesday now*, after school."

stim.head: Listen to Tuan and his mum.
lines: Tuan, I've moved your visit to the dentist.
No, the dentist is busy on Monday. It's on Wednesday now, after school.
Good, because I've got football on Tuesday.

v.q: When is Ngoc's birthday party?
whys: The twelfth is Ngoc's birthday, but the party is on a different day.
The twentieth is the day of Elliot's cousin's party.
v.hint: A birthday and a birthday party can be on different days.
v.worked: Ngoc says "*The party is on the fifteenth*. That's a Saturday."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and Ngoc.
lines: Ngoc, is your birthday party on the twelfth of June?
My birthday is on the twelfth, but it's a school day. The party is on the fifteenth. That's a Saturday.
Great! My cousin's party is on the twentieth, so I'm free.
Brilliant. I'll give you an invitation tomorrow.

title.en: Traps: changed plans and wrong guesses
title.vi: Bẫy: đổi kế hoạch và đoán sai

v.q: What will the class play at the party?
whys: Football was the first plan, but it's going to rain.
Nam wanted a treasure hunt, but that is not the plan.
v.hint: Listen for the word so. What does the teacher say after the rain?
v.worked: Lucy says "*So* the teacher says we'll play *board games* in the classroom."

stim.head: Listen to Nam and Lucy.
lines: Lucy, are we playing football at the class party tomorrow?
We were going to, but it's going to rain. So the teacher says we'll play board games in the classroom.
Oh. I wanted to do a treasure hunt.

v.q: What's wrong with Lucy?
whys: Mum guesses a headache, but Lucy says her head is OK.
Lucy had a fever last week, not today.
v.hint: Mum makes a guess. Listen to Lucy's answer.
v.worked: Lucy says "My head's OK. *It's my tooth*. It really hurts when I eat."

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her mum.
lines: Lucy, you don't look well. Have you got a headache?
No, Mum. My head's OK. It's my tooth. It really hurts when I eat.
Oh dear. You had a fever last week, and now this!
Can I see the dentist tomorrow?

v.q: What did Raj buy for the party?
whys: The strawberry cakes were all sold out.
The big chocolate cake was too expensive.
v.hint: Two cakes were not possible. Why?
v.worked: Raj says "I bought *six cupcakes instead*."

stim.head: Listen to Raj and his dad.
lines: Dad, the bakery had no strawberry cakes. They were all sold out.
Oh no. Did you get a big chocolate cake, then?
That was too expensive. I bought six cupcakes instead.
Good choice. We can put a candle on each one.

v.q: Where did Clara go on Sunday?
whys: Clara wanted to go to the museum, but it was closed.
The cinema is where Elliot went with his dad.
v.hint: Clara's first plan didn't work. Listen for instead.
v.worked: Clara says "So we went to *the zoo instead*."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and Clara.
lines: Clara, did you go to the museum on Sunday?
We wanted to, but it was closed. So we went to the zoo instead. The giraffes were amazing!
Cool. I went to the cinema with my dad.

v.q: What did Elliot use to take photos at the festival?
whys: Elliot's camera is broken.
Dad's video camera was too heavy to carry.
v.hint: Two things were not possible. Listen for the reasons.
v.worked: Elliot says "*So I used Mum's phone*."

stim.head: Listen to Grace and Elliot.
lines: Elliot, your festival photos are great! Did you use your camera?
No, my camera's broken. Dad's video camera was too heavy to carry. So I used Mum's phone.
Wow. The pictures are really clear.
Thanks! Mum wants me to take photos at every festival now.

v.q: What did Ngoc win at the school fair?
whys: Tuan guesses a teddy bear, but the teddy bears were for the little children.
Tuan is the one who won a pencil.
v.hint: Tuan makes a guess. Does Ngoc say yes or no?
v.worked: Ngoc says "*I won a football*!"

stim.head: Listen to Tuan and Ngoc.
lines: Ngoc, what did you win at the school fair? A teddy bear?
No, the teddy bears were for the little children. I won a football!
Lucky you. I only won a pencil.
A pencil is useful! We can play football at break.

v.q: Book fair date:
v.hint: Two dates are said. Which one is for this year?
v.worked: The teacher says "*this year it's on the ninth of March*", so write 9.

stim.head:
Listen to the teacher. Complete the note.
BOOK FAIR
Date: ________ March
lines: Hello, everyone. The school book fair is coming soon. Last year it was on the second of March, but this year it's on the ninth of March. It starts at nine o'clock in the school hall. You can buy books, and you can meet a real writer.

v.q: Chess club day:
v.hint: Listen for this term. Last term is the old day.
v.worked: The teacher says "*this term we're meeting on Thursdays*".

stim.head:
Listen to the teacher. Complete the note.
CHESS CLUB
Day: ________
lines: Good news! Chess club starts again next week. Last term we met on Mondays, but this term we're meeting on Thursdays, after lunch. We play in the library. Bring a friend if they want to learn!

v.q: Arrive at, and cost:
v.hint: Two times are said. Which one goes with arrive?
v.worked: "Please *arrive at quarter to ten*" (9:45). The workshop "*costs six pounds*".

stim.head:
Listen to the gardener. Complete the notes.
CHILDREN'S GARDEN WORKSHOP
Arrive at: ________
Cost: £________
lines: Hello, families. Our garden workshop for children is on Saturday at the town park. Please arrive at quarter to ten, because we start at ten o'clock. The children will plant tomatoes and beans in pots. The workshop costs six pounds, and that includes a pot and some seeds to take home.

v.q: Be at the park at, and the place:
v.hint: The match starts at one time, but you must arrive earlier. Which park is it now?
v.worked: "Please *be at the park at three o'clock*". "So now it's at *City* Park."

stim.head:
Listen to the football coach. Complete the notes.
SUNDAY MATCH
Be at the park at: ________
Place: ________ Park
lines: Hi, team. Our match on Sunday starts at half past three, but please be at the park at three o'clock. The match was going to be at Hill School, but their field is too wet. So now it's at City Park. Bring a bottle of water and your green shirt.

v.q: Children in each group, and what to bring:
v.hint: Two numbers are said. Which one is for this time?
v.worked: "Please work in *groups of four*, not five like last time" and "bring a *notebook*".

stim.head:
Listen to the teacher. Complete the notes.
MOSQUITO HUNT
Children in each group: ________
Bring: a ________
lines: Tomorrow we're going to look for standing water around the school, because mosquitoes lay their eggs in it. This time, please work in groups of four, not five like last time. Wear long sleeves, and bring a notebook to write down what you find.

v.q: Price, and what to bring:
v.hint: Listen for the price after cost. A day is said too, but it is not a price.
v.worked: "Tea and cake *cost one pound fifty*" and "bring a *photo* of your grandparents".

stim.head:
Listen to the teacher. Complete the notes.
GRANDPARENTS' AFTERNOON
Tea and cake: £________
Bring: a ________ of your grandparents
lines: On Friday, we're having a Grandparents' Afternoon at school. Your grandparents can watch our songs and have tea with us. Tea and cake cost one pound fifty for each visitor. Please bring the money on Wednesday, not on Friday. And bring a photo of your grandparents for our display.

blurb.en: Listening Part 1 and Part 2, just like the real exam.
blurb.vi: Phần 1 và Phần 2 của bài Nghe, giống như bài thi thật.

v.q: What does Clara's aunt do now?
whys: Clara's aunt was a teacher for ten years, but not now.
Jack's uncle is the firefighter.
v.hint: The question says now. Listen for was and now.
v.worked: Clara says "*Now she's a doctor* at the children's hospital."

stim.head: Listen to Clara and Jack.
lines: Jack, my aunt is my hero. She was a teacher for ten years.
No, now she's a doctor at the children's hospital. She studied for years!
Wow. My uncle is a firefighter. He's very brave.

v.q: What did Aisha have for breakfast today?
whys: Dad asks about cereal, but Aisha says no.
Rice is for lunch, not for breakfast today.
v.hint: Dad makes a guess. Listen to Aisha's answer.
v.worked: Aisha says "I wasn't very hungry, so I just had *a banana*."

stim.head: Listen to Aisha and her dad.
lines: Aisha, did you have cereal this morning?
No, I wasn't very hungry, so I just had a banana.
Just a banana? You need more than that!
I know. Can we have rice together at lunch?

v.q: Which club is Raj joining?
whys: Grace guesses the art club, but Raj isn't very good at drawing.
The music club is Grace's club.
v.hint: Grace guesses first. Does Raj agree?
v.worked: Raj says "*I'm joining the drama club*. I want to be less shy."

stim.head: Listen to Grace and Raj.
lines: Raj, which club are you joining this term? The art club?
No, I'm not very good at drawing. I'm joining the drama club. I want to be less shy.
That's a great idea. I'm in the music club.
I know! I heard you singing on Tuesday.

v.q: How many friends are coming to Elliot's party?
whys: Ten friends said yes at first, but two can't come.
Two is the number of friends who are on holiday.
v.hint: Listen for a number, then listen for what changed.
v.worked: Elliot says "two are on holiday. *So eight are coming*."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and his mum.
lines: Elliot, how many friends are coming to your party? Ten?
Ten said yes at first, but two are on holiday. So eight are coming.
OK. Then we need eight party bags.

v.q: Where does Grace live now?
whys: Grace lived on her grandpa's farm, but she left last year.
A house with a garden is what Grace wants one day.
v.hint: Listen for now and last year.
v.worked: Grace says "*We live in a flat in the city now*."

stim.head: Listen to Nam and Grace.
lines: Grace, do you still live on your grandpa's farm?
No, we left the farm last year. We live in a flat in the city now.
It's OK, but I miss the animals. I want a house with a garden one day.

v.q: What will Lucy watch at New Year?
whys: Lucy can't watch the fireworks, because her sister is afraid of the noise.
Tuan says there is music in the park, but Lucy is going to the lion dance.
v.hint: Lucy says I can't. Then listen for so.
v.worked: Lucy says "*So we're going to watch the lion dance* in the afternoon."

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and Tuan.
lines: Tuan, are you going to watch the fireworks at New Year?
I can't. My little sister is afraid of the noise. So we're going to watch the lion dance in the afternoon.
The lion dance is great. There's music in the park too.

v.q: What time will Aisha phone her uncle?
whys: It's six o'clock now, but her uncle is asleep in London.
Eleven o'clock is the time in London now.
v.hint: Dad says he's asleep. Then listen for when Aisha can call.
v.worked: Dad says "*Call him at four this afternoon*." Then it's nine in the morning in London.

stim.head: Listen to Aisha and her dad.
lines: Dad, can I call my uncle in London now? It's six o'clock in the morning here.
London is seven hours behind us. It's eleven o'clock at night there. He's asleep!
Oh! So when can I call him?
Call him at four this afternoon. Then it's nine in the morning in London.

v.q: What will stop the mosquitoes biting Jack?
whys: Jack's long trousers are wet, so he can't wear them.
Mum says a hat won't help.
v.hint: Two ideas don't work. Listen for why.
v.worked: Mum says "*put some of this cream* on your arms and legs."

stim.head: Listen to Jack and his mum.
lines: Mum, I'm going to play in the garden.
There are lots of mosquitoes in the evening. Put on your long trousers.
They're wet. I washed them after football. Can I wear my sun hat?
A hat won't help! Here, put some of this cream on your arms and legs.

v.q: What did Nam draw with chalk on the playground?
whys: Clara guesses a hole, but Tuan drew the hole.
Clara is the one who drew a shark.
v.hint: Clara guesses. Who drew that picture?
v.worked: Nam says "*I drew a river with a little bridge*."

stim.head: Listen to Clara and Nam.
lines: Nam, what did you draw with chalk on the playground? The big hole?
No, Tuan drew the hole. People really jumped over it! I drew a river with a little bridge.
Cool! I drew a shark. It looks like it's coming out of the ground.
I saw it. It's a bit scary!

v.q: What was in this place just before the library?
whys: The cinema was there a long time ago, before the market.
The library is there now. The question asks what was there before it.
v.hint: Grandma talks about three times: long ago, later and now. Put them in order.
v.worked: Grandma says the cinema closed, "*and then there was a market* for many years". Then they built the library.

items.en: Part 1: read the question and look at the three pictures first. All three will be *mentioned*, so listen for the one that answers the question.
items.vi: Phần 1: đọc câu hỏi và nhìn ba bức tranh trước. Cả ba đều được nhắc đến, nên hãy nghe xem tranh nào trả lời đúng câu hỏi.
example: You hear: Grandpa's train arrives at seven. We'll *eat at eight*. You can have a snack at five.

items.en: When a plan *changes*, the new choice usually comes after *but*, *so* or *instead*.
items.vi: Khi kế hoạch thay đổi, lựa chọn mới thường đến sau *but*, *so* hoặc *instead*.
example: We wanted to go to the museum, *but* it was closed.

items.en: Listen for *corrections*. After *No*, *actually* or *that was last year*, the true information comes.
items.vi: Hãy nghe những lần sửa lại. Sau *No*, *actually* hoặc *that was last year* là thông tin đúng.
example: Is it on Monday? *No, actually* it's on Wednesday.
Four pounds? *That was last year*. This year it's five.

items.en: Know your clock words: *half past* = :30, *quarter past* = :15, *quarter to* = :45 of the hour before.
items.vi: Hãy nhớ các từ chỉ giờ: *half past* = 30 phút, *quarter past* = 15 phút, *quarter to* = kém 15 phút (45 phút của giờ trước).

items.en: Numbers, prices and dates: *-teen* and *-ty* sound close. *Four pounds fifty* = £4.50. *The ninth of May* = 9 May.
items.vi: Số, giá tiền và ngày tháng: *-teen* và *-ty* nghe gần giống nhau. Four pounds fifty = £4.50. The ninth of May = ngày 9 tháng 5.
example: The trip is on *the third* of November: write 3.

items.en: Part 2: write *one word* or *a number*. Some words are printed already, so write only the *missing part*.
items.vi: Phần 2: viết một từ hoặc một con số. Một số từ đã được in sẵn, nên em chỉ viết phần còn thiếu.

check.sentence: In Part 1, all three pictures are usually {mentioned|missing|the same} in the talk.
"The museum was closed, so we went to the zoo instead." They went to the {zoo|museum|park}.
"Is it on Monday?" "No, actually it's on Wednesday." The day is {Wednesday|Monday|Tuesday}.
Notes: "Date: ____ October". You hear "the fourteenth of October". Write {14|14 October|October}.

v.q: 1 Date of the trip:
v.hint: A day of the week is said next to the date. October is printed, so write only the number.
v.worked: The teacher says "We're going on *the fourteenth of October*", so write 14.

stim.head:
Listen to the teacher talking about a class trip. Complete the notes.
CLASS 4 FARM TRIP
Place: Sunny Fields Farm (example)
1 Date: ________ October
2 The coach leaves at: ________
3 Children in each group: ________
4 After lunch: make ________ salad
5 Cost: £________
lines: Good morning, Class 4. Next month, we're visiting Sunny Fields Farm to learn about healthy food. We're going on the fourteenth of October. That's a Tuesday. Please come to school by eight o'clock, because the coach leaves at quarter past eight. We'll be back at school at three o'clock. There are thirty children in our class, so we'll have five groups. There are six children in each group, and every group has a farmer to help. In the morning, you'll pick apples and carrots. After lunch, you'll make fruit salad. Last year we fed the goats, but this year the goats are too young. The trip costs nine pounds. That includes a drink and a snack. Please bring the money by Friday. Wear old shoes, and bring a hat and a raincoat. See you there!

lines: Hello, Class 4. I've got some news about our trip to the Old Town Museum. We're going there to learn how our town looked a hundred years ago. There's an old street with shops and a school from the past. We were going to go on the twenty-seventh of October, but the museum is closed that week. So the trip is on the third of November. We'll leave school at half past nine, and we'll come back at two o'clock. In the morning, you can choose drawing or a quiz. In the afternoon, everyone will wear a costume and visit an old classroom. The ticket costs four pounds fifty. Please bring the money by Thursday. You don't need a packed lunch, because the museum café will give us soup and bread. Please bring a pencil and a ruler. Any questions? Come and ask me.

v.q: What does Grace like best at the Tet feast?
whys: Grace says the sticky rice cake is nice, but too chewy for her.
The coconut sweets are Nam's favourite. They are too sweet for Grace.
v.hint: Grace talks about three foods. Which one does she like best?
v.worked: Grace says "*I love the chicken soup best*."

stim.head: Listen to Nam and Grace.
lines: Grace, what's your favourite food at the Tet feast? The sticky rice cake?
It's nice, but it's a bit too chewy for me. I love the chicken soup best.
Really? I like the coconut sweets best.

whys: The neighbour's son usually carries her shopping.
Jack watered the neighbour's plants last week.
v.hint: Jack makes a guess. Does Clara say yes?

Her son usually does that. I walked her dog, because her leg hurts.
That's kind. I watered her plants last week.
She told me! She says we're both very helpful.

whys: The bowling centre is closed on Sundays.
It's going to rain on Sunday, so the park is not a good idea.
v.hint: Two places are not possible. Listen for why.
v.worked: Mum says "*let's have it at the pizza restaurant* near the market", and Lucy says yes.

stim.head: Listen to Lucy and her mum.
lines: Mum, can I have my party at the bowling centre?
It's closed on Sundays, love. What about the park?
It's going to rain on Sunday.
